title: Knight Capital lost $440M in 45 minutes to a dead flag
body: In 2012 Knight deployed new code to seven of eight servers; the eighth kept old code where a repurposed flag reactivated a long-dead routine that fired orders endlessly. There was no kill switch rehearsed for it. The firm lost about 440 million dollars before the market closed and never recovered independence. Deployment asymmetry plus flag reuse, not a trading algorithm, did it.
